audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim Moab-covenant renewal and hidden-things discourse, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Moab covenant beyond Horeb, wilderness provision, inclusive assembly, present and absent generations, anti-idolatry warning, collective catastrophe rhetoric, exile imagery, and hidden/revealed things.

verses.restored: These are words of covenant that YHWH commanded Moses to cut with children of Israel in land of Moab, besides covenant he cut with them at Horeb.

familiar.text: These are the words of the covenant, which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

modern.text: These are the words of the covenant that the LORD commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant He had made with them at Horeb.

original.text: אֵלֶּה֩ דִבְרֵ֨י הַבְּרִ֜ית אֲֽשֶׁר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֣ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֗ה לִכְרֹ֛ת אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב מִלְּבַ֣ד הַבְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁר כָּרַ֥ת אִתָּ֖ם בְּחֹרֵֽב

verses.restored: Moses called to all Israel and said to them: You saw all YHWH did before your eyes in land of Egypt to Pharaoh, all his servants, and all his land,

familiar.text: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;

modern.text: Moses summoned all Israel and proclaimed to them, “You have seen with your own eyes everything the LORD did in Egypt to Pharaoh, to all his officials, and to all his land.

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֗ם אֵ֣ת כָּל אֲשֶׁר֩ עָשָׂ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה לְעֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לְפַרְעֹ֥ה וּלְכָל עֲבָדָ֖יו וּלְכָל אַרְצֽוֹ

verses.restored: the great trials your eyes saw, signs, and those great wonders.

familiar.text: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:

modern.text: You saw with your own eyes the great trials, and those miraculous signs and wonders.

original.text: הַמַּסּוֹת֙ הַגְּדֹלֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָא֖וּ עֵינֶ֑יךָ הָאֹתֹ֧ת וְהַמֹּפְתִ֛ים הַגְּדֹלִ֖ים הָהֵֽם

verses.restored: Yet YHWH has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, or ears to hear until this day.

familiar.text: Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.

modern.text: Yet to this day the LORD has not given you a mind to understand, eyes to see, or ears to hear.

original.text: וְלֹֽא נָתַן֩ יְהוָ֨ה לָכֶ֥ם לֵב֙ לָדַ֔עַת וְעֵינַ֥יִם לִרְא֖וֹת וְאָזְנַ֣יִם לִשְׁמֹ֑עַ עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: I led you forty years in wilderness; your garments did not wear out upon you, and your sandal did not wear out upon your foot.

familiar.text: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.

modern.text: For forty years I led you in the wilderness, yet your clothes and sandals did not wear out.

original.text: וָאוֹלֵ֥ךְ אֶתְכֶ֛ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לֹֽא בָל֤וּ שַׂלְמֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְנַֽעַלְךָ֥ לֹֽא בָלְתָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל רַגְלֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Bread you did not eat, and wine or strong drink you did not drink, so you might know that I am YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I am the LORD your God.

modern.text: You ate no bread and drank no wine or strong drink, so that you might know that I am the LORD your God.

original.text: לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אֲכַלְתֶּ֔ם וְיַ֥יִן וְשֵׁכָ֖ר לֹ֣א שְׁתִיתֶ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: You came to this place, and Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out to meet us for battle, and we struck them.

familiar.text: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:

modern.text: When you reached this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out against us in battle, but we defeated them.

original.text: וַתָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וַיֵּצֵ֣א סִיחֹ֣ן מֶֽלֶךְ חֶ֠שְׁבּוֹן וְע֨וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֧ן לִקְרָאתֵ֛נוּ לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה וַנַּכֵּֽם

verses.restored: We took their land and gave it as inheritance to Reubenites, Gadites, and half tribe of Manasseh.

familiar.text: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.

modern.text: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

original.text: וַנִּקַּח֙ אֶת אַרְצָ֔ם וַנִּתְּנָ֣הּ לְנַחֲלָ֔ה לָרֽאוּבֵנִ֖י וְלַגָּדִ֑י וְלַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֥בֶט הַֽמְנַשִּֽׁי

verses.restored: You shall keep words of this covenant and do them, so you may act wisely/prosper in all you do.

familiar.text: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.

modern.text: So keep and follow the words of this covenant, that you may prosper in all you do.

original.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֗ם אֶת דִּבְרֵי֙ הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֔את וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם לְמַ֣עַן תַּשְׂכִּ֔ילוּ אֵ֖ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֽׂוּן

verses.restored: You are standing today, all of you, before YHWH your Divine: heads of your tribes, your elders, your officers, every man of Israel,

familiar.text: Ye stand this day all of you before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Israel,

modern.text: All of you are standing today before the LORD your God—you leaders of tribes, elders, officials, and all the men of Israel,

original.text: אַתֶּ֨ם נִצָּבִ֤ים הַיּוֹם֙ כֻּלְּכֶ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם רָאשֵׁיכֶ֣ם שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֗ם זִקְנֵיכֶם֙ וְשֹׁ֣טְרֵיכֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ל אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: your little ones, your wives, and your sojourner who is in midst of your camp, from cutter of your wood to drawer of your water,

familiar.text: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:

modern.text: your children and wives, and the foreigners in your camps who cut your wood and draw your water—

original.text: טַפְּכֶ֣ם נְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם וְגֵ֣רְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֶ֑יךָ מֵחֹטֵ֣ב עֵצֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד שֹׁאֵ֥ב מֵימֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: for you to pass into covenant of YHWH your Divine and into his oath that YHWH your Divine cuts with you today,

familiar.text: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the LORD thy God, and into his oath, which the LORD thy God maketh with thee this day:

modern.text: so that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, which He is making with you today, and into His oath,

original.text: לְעָבְרְךָ֗ בִּבְרִ֛ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וּבְאָלָת֑וֹ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כֹּרֵ֥ת עִמְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם

verses.restored: in order to establish you today as a people for himself and that he may be Divine for you, as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

familiar.text: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

modern.text: and so that He may establish you today as His people, and He may be your God as He promised you and as He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

original.text: לְמַ֣עַן הָקִֽים אֹתְךָ֩ הַיּ֨וֹם ל֜וֹ לְעָ֗ם וְה֤וּא יִֽהְיֶה לְּךָ֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר לָ֑ךְ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּע֙ לַאֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹֽב

verses.restored: Not with you alone do I cut this covenant and this oath,

familiar.text: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;

modern.text: I am making this covenant and this oath not only with you,

original.text: וְלֹ֥א אִתְּכֶ֖ם לְבַדְּכֶ֑ם אָנֹכִ֗י כֹּרֵת֙ אֶת הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֔את וְאֶת הָאָלָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת

verses.restored: but with the one who stands here with us today before YHWH our Divine and with the one who is not here with us today.

familiar.text: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:

modern.text: but also with those who are standing here with us today in the presence of the LORD our God, as well as with those who are not here today.

original.text: כִּי֩ אֶת אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֶשְׁנ֜וֹ פֹּ֗ה עִמָּ֨נוּ֙ עֹמֵ֣ד הַיּ֔וֹם לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְאֵ֨ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵינֶ֛נּוּ פֹּ֖ה עִמָּ֥נוּ הַיּֽוֹם

verses.restored: For you know how we dwelt in land of Egypt and how we passed through midst of nations through which you passed.

familiar.text: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;

modern.text: For you yourselves know how we lived in the land of Egypt and how we passed through the nations on the way here.

original.text: כִּֽי אַתֶּ֣ם יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁ֖בְנוּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְאֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר עָבַ֛רְנוּ בְּקֶ֥רֶב הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲבַרְתֶּֽם

verses.restored: You saw their detestable things and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were with them.

familiar.text: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)

modern.text: You saw the abominations and idols among them made of wood and stone, of silver and gold.

original.text: וַתִּרְאוּ֙ אֶת שִׁקּ֣וּצֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת גִּלֻּלֵיהֶ֑ם עֵ֣ץ וָאֶ֔בֶן כֶּ֥סֶף וְזָהָ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִמָּהֶֽם

verses.restored: Lest there be among you man or woman or clan or tribe whose heart turns today from YHWH our Divine to go serve gods of those nations, lest there be among you a root bearing poison and wormwood.

familiar.text: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the LORD our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;

modern.text: Make sure there is no man or woman, clan or tribe among you today whose heart turns away from the LORD our God to go and worship the gods of those nations. Make sure there is no root among you that bears such poisonous and bitter fruit,

original.text: פֶּן יֵ֣שׁ בָּ֠כֶם אִ֣ישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁ֞ה א֧וֹ מִשְׁפָּחָ֣ה אוֹ שֵׁ֗בֶט אֲשֶׁר֩ לְבָב֨וֹ פֹנֶ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ מֵעִם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ לָלֶ֣כֶת לַעֲבֹ֔ד אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֖י הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָהֵ֑ם פֶּן יֵ֣שׁ בָּכֶ֗ם שֹׁ֛רֶשׁ פֹּרֶ֥ה רֹ֖אשׁ וְלַעֲנָֽה

verses.restored: It shall be, when he hears words of this oath and blesses himself in his heart, saying, Peace shall be for me, though I walk in stubbornness of my heart, to sweep away the watered with the dry,

familiar.text: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:

modern.text: because when such a person hears the words of this oath, he invokes a blessing on himself, saying, ‘I will have peace, even though I walk in the stubbornness of my own heart.’ This will bring disaster on the watered land as well as the dry.

original.text: וְהָיָ֡ה בְּשָׁמְעוֹ֩ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֨י הָֽאָלָ֜ה הַזֹּ֗את וְהִתְבָּרֵ֨ךְ בִּלְבָב֤וֹ לֵאמֹר֙ שָׁל֣וֹם יִֽהְיֶה לִּ֔י כִּ֛י בִּשְׁרִר֥וּת לִבִּ֖י אֵלֵ֑ךְ לְמַ֛עַן סְפ֥וֹת הָרָוָ֖ה אֶת הַצְּמֵאָֽה

verses.restored: YHWH will not be willing to forgive him; then anger of YHWH and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all oath written in this scroll will rest upon him, and YHWH will blot out his name from under heavens.

familiar.text: The LORD will not spare him, but then the anger of the LORD and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven.

modern.text: The LORD will never be willing to forgive him. Instead, His anger and jealousy will burn against that man, and every curse written in this book will fall upon him. The LORD will blot out his name from under heaven

original.text: לֹא יֹאבֶ֣ה יְהוָה֮ סְלֹ֣חַֽ לוֹ֒ כִּ֣י אָ֠ז יֶעְשַׁ֨ן אַף יְהוָ֤ה וְקִנְאָתוֹ֙ בָּאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא וְרָ֤בְצָה בּוֹ֙ כָּל הָ֣אָלָ֔ה הַכְּתוּבָ֖ה בַּסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֑ה וּמָחָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת שְׁמ֔וֹ מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם

verses.restored: YHWH will separate him for evil from all tribes of Israel, according to all oaths of covenant written in this scroll of Torah/instruction.

familiar.text: And the LORD shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:

modern.text: and single him out from all the tribes of Israel for disaster, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.

original.text: וְהִבְדִּיל֤וֹ יְהוָה֙ לְרָעָ֔ה מִכֹּ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּכֹל֙ אָל֣וֹת הַבְּרִ֔ית הַכְּתוּבָ֕ה בְּסֵ֥פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֖ה הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: The later generation, your children who rise after you, and foreigner who comes from distant land, shall say when they see plagues of that land and its sicknesses with which YHWH afflicted it—

familiar.text: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD hath laid upon it;

modern.text: Then the generation to come—your sons who follow you and the foreigner who comes from a distant land—will see the plagues of the land and the sicknesses the LORD has inflicted on it.

original.text: וְאָמַ֞ר הַדּ֣וֹר הָֽאַחֲר֗וֹן בְּנֵיכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָק֨וּמוּ֙ מֵאַ֣חֲרֵיכֶ֔ם וְהַ֨נָּכְרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֖א מֵאֶ֣רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֑ה וְ֠רָאוּ אֶת מַכּ֞וֹת הָאָ֤רֶץ הַהִוא֙ וְאֶת תַּ֣חֲלֻאֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁר חִלָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה בָּֽהּ

verses.restored: all its land brimstone, salt, and burning, not sown and not sprouting and no grass rising in it, like overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which YHWH overthrew in his anger and fury—

familiar.text: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:

modern.text: All its soil will be a burning waste of sulfur and salt, unsown and unproductive, with no plant growing on it, just like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in His fierce anger.

original.text: גָּפְרִ֣ית וָמֶלַח֮ שְׂרֵפָ֣ה כָל אַרְצָהּ֒ לֹ֤א תִזָּרַע֙ וְלֹ֣א תַצְמִ֔חַ וְלֹֽא יַעֲלֶ֥ה בָ֖הּ כָּל עֵ֑שֶׂב כְּֽמַהְפֵּכַ֞ת סְדֹ֤ם וַעֲמֹרָה֙ אַדְמָ֣ה וצביים אֲשֶׁר֙ הָפַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה בְּאַפּ֖וֹ וּבַחֲמָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: all nations shall say, Why did YHWH do thus to this land? What is heat of this great anger?

familiar.text: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?

modern.text: So all the nations will ask, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land? Why this great outburst of anger?’

original.text: וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ כָּל הַגּוֹיִ֔ם עַל מֶ֨ה עָשָׂ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה כָּ֖כָה לָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את מֶ֥ה חֳרִ֛י הָאַ֥ף הַגָּד֖וֹל הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: Then they shall say, Because they abandoned covenant of YHWH, Divine of their fathers, which he cut with them when he brought them out from land of Egypt,

familiar.text: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:

translation_notes: English and Hebrew traditions may attach verse 1 to the previous chapter; this file follows common English chapter numbering.
The covenant assembly explicitly includes leaders, men, women, children, immigrants, and laborers from woodcutter to water drawer.
The covenant reaches those present and those 'not here,' extending responsibility across generations without erasing personal agency.
The phrase about a root bearing poison warns against hidden covenant corruption and must not become permission to scapegoat minority people or families.
Stiff-necked or stubborn-heart language is internal covenant critique and must never support antisemitic stereotypes.
The devastated-land imagery is ancient covenant-curse rhetoric and cannot be used to blame modern victims of war, drought, contamination, exile, or ecological disaster.
The final verse limits speculative certainty: hidden matters belong to YHWH, while revealed instruction is given for communal practice.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 29 to justify collective punishment, antisemitism, conspiracy claims about hidden evil, religious exclusion, exile theology, or disaster blame. Center the covenant's radically broad assembly, intergenerational responsibility, humility about hidden things, and practical obedience to what has actually been revealed.
